title: One Movie to Rule Them All...
seo_title: One Movie to Rule Them All Movie Night in Joplin, MO
description: This library movie night celebrates a film's 25th anniversary with a showing of the theatrical version (178 minutes, rated PG-13) in the Community Room, and you can craft hobbit or elf ears before the show starts. Blankets and snacks are welcome, and popcorn is provided; it is designed with teens and adults in mind. It takes place December 3, 2026, Time TBD, at Joplin Public Library, 1915 S Connecticut Ave in Joplin, MO.
